column1: # What sync-env.sh ships from the local agix store to the VPS.
# Columns, whitespace-separated:  <agix name>  <target .env>  <name on the server>
# A name agix does not hold is reported and skipped, so this file is also the
# list of what is still unset. Add one with: agix secret set <NAME>
# Values never appear here — only names.
# Mint a token scoped to the vibe-backups bucket; do NOT reuse the media keys.
# Without these the alert rules fire but no mail leaves the box.
# Already live on the box; mapped so a rotation can be re-shipped in one command.
